name: Sports Night
description: The offbeat cast and crew of a sports news show deal with professional, personal, and ethical challenges while functioning in a pressure-cooker work environment.

videos.title: The Show
videos.overview: All-new interviews with Josh Charles, Felicity Huffman, Peter Krause, Joshua Malina, Robert Guillaume, show creator Aaron Sorkin, Director/executive producer Thomas Schlamme and more cast and crew reveal the story of Sports Night, from inception to cancellation to legacy.

videos.title: Face-Off: ESPN's SportsCenter vx. CSC's Sports Night
videos.overview: The real-life counterparts to Sports Night's fictional team tell us what the show got right.  Featuring SportsCenter anchors Josh Elliot and Jay Harris, Senior Coordinating Producers Glenn Jacobs and Michael Schiffman, Associate Producer Elizabeth Sosbee and Researcher David Rose.

videos.title: Looking Back
videos.overview: An intimate conversation with Aaron Sorkin and THomas Schlamme.

videos.title: Inside the Locker Room
videos.overview: A behind the scenes wlook at the creeative and technical innovation of Sports Night.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: Dejected by his divorce and the state of sports, Casey contemplates leaving "Sports Night". Natalie has a crush on an applicant for an associate producer position.

videos.title: The Apology
videos.overview: The network is upset when a newly-published magazine interview reveals that Dan is in favor of the legalization of marijuana.

videos.title: The Hungry and the Hunted
videos.overview: Jeremy gets his first big producing break - a hunting segment. Natalie tries to get Casey interested in Dana during the run-up to one of Luther Sach's dinner parties.

videos.title: Intellectual Property
videos.overview: Casey's jealousy over Dana and Gordon leaves him kicking fire hydrants and hearing phantom flies. Dan faces repercussions from the network for his birthday present to Casey.

videos.title: Mary Pat Shelby
videos.overview: Natalie does a pre-interview with a volatile football player and things get out of hand.

videos.title: The Head Coach, Dinner and the Morning Mail
videos.overview: A distracted Natalie keeps forgetting things, while Jeremy tries to shield her from her hate mail.

videos.title: Dear Louise
videos.overview: Jeremy writes a letter to his sister Louise, flashing back over the day's events, including Dan's problems with writer's block and Isaac's problems with his daughter's new boyfriend.

videos.title: Thespis
videos.overview: Dana worries about her Thanksgiving turkey, Isaac worries about his pregnant daughter, and the ghost of Thespis wreaks havoc on the set.

videos.title: The Quality of Mercy at 29K
videos.overview: The team anchors a broadcast from Mt. Everest, Dana sees a Broadway show, and Dan tries to find a worthy charity.

videos.title: Shoe Money Tonight
videos.overview: Dan and Casey are Atlantic City-bound after the broadcast, Natalie and Jeremy have a fight, and Isaac discovers he's shrinking.

videos.title: The Six Southern Gentlemen of Tennessee
videos.overview: Casey appears on _"View, The" (1997)_ and the team follows the story of seven college football players who are suspended for refusing to play under the Confederate flag.

videos.title: Smoky
videos.overview: Dan decides that it's time Casey started dating again, so long as he stays away from Sally Sasser. Isaac fears for his job.

videos.title: Small Town
videos.overview: Dana, Gordon, Casey, and a woman from Gordon's office go on a double-date, leaving Natalie to produce the show and Dan to contend with a replacement anchor.

videos.title: Rebecca
videos.overview: Dan obsesses over a woman who works in the building, and everyone worries about Isaac's job.

videos.title: Dana and the Deep Blue Sea
videos.overview: Gordon invites Dana to go snorkeling, and Dan begs Jeremy to talk him up to Rebecca.

videos.title: Sally
videos.overview: Gordon stands Dana up, and Casey's missing his favorite shirt.

videos.title: How Are Things in Glocca Morra?
videos.overview: The show is held up when a tennis match goes longer than expected, putting a damper on Dana and Gordon's dinner plans.

videos.title: The Sword of Orion
videos.overview: Jeremy's parents are getting divorced, and Dan eagerly awaits Orlando Rojas' return to baseball.

videos.title: Eli's Coming
videos.overview: Isaac is late coming back from vacation, Bobbi Bernstein returns, and Steve Sisco visits Rebecca.

videos.title: Ordnance Tactics
videos.overview: A bomb scare clears the building, Jeremy tries to break up with Natalie, and the network starts pressuring Dana.

videos.title: Ten Wickets
videos.overview: Casey is still rattled from the bomb scare, Jeremy tries to understand a cricket story, and Rebecca makes her decision about Dan.

videos.title: Napoleon's Battle Plan
videos.overview: When Dana and Gordon get engaged, Casey has no plan and Dan's compelled to reveal a secret.

videos.title: What Kind of Day Has It Been
videos.overview: Casey's son comes to visit, and Dana takes a group photo with her new camera. Season One Finale.

videos.title: Special Powers
videos.overview: Casey tries to find the courage to ask Dana out, Isaac's back at work, and Jeremy and Natalie have a fight.

videos.title: When Something Wicked This Way Comes
videos.overview: Dana goes to a bachelorette party and has an epiphany, Dan has breakfast with Hillary Clinton, and Isaac brings in a ratings guy.

videos.title: Cliff Gardner
videos.overview: The staff are stressed out by Sam Donovan's presence, and things get worse when J.J. stops by to give them notes.

videos.title: Louise Revisited
videos.overview: Casey does everything he can to win the Sports Night “Who's Cooler: Dan or Casey?” internet poll. Dana has dinner with an old school friend.

videos.title: Kafelnikov
videos.overview: Jeremy readies the show's computer systems for Y2K. Dan meets a woman in a bar, discovering later that she's a psychologist.

videos.title: Shane
videos.overview: Casey wants to edit an interview to cast a ballplayer in a more favorable light, Dan has trouble taping a teaser, and The Vatican declares there's no such place as Hell.

videos.title: Kyle Whitaker's Got Two Sacks
videos.overview: Jeremy has to fire an intern, and the team covers breaking news of a football steroid scandal.

videos.title: The Reunion
videos.overview: Dana's brother comes to visit. Natalie asks Dan to review her audition tape.

videos.title: A Girl Named Pixley
videos.overview: It's a very slow news day, Casey goes on a date with a woman named Pixley, and Jeremy is up for an award.

videos.title: The Giants Win the Pennant, the Giants Win the Pennant
videos.overview: Dana begins to see the flaw in her dating plan. Dan wants to use Isaac in a feature on the 1951 New York Giants pennant win.

videos.title: The Cut Man Cometh
videos.overview: Dan and Casey cover a boxing match. Dan's father visits.

videos.title: The Sweet Smell of Air
videos.overview: The show lands an interview with Michael Jordan but there are a few strings attached. Sam returns.

videos.title: Dana Get Your Gun
videos.overview: Dan tries to get the night off for a Tom Waits concert. Dana inherits a gun.

videos.title: And the Crowd Goes Wild
videos.overview: It's Sam's last day at the show, Jeremy and Natalie break up, and Casey gets his eyes examined.

videos.title: Celebrities
videos.overview: Natalie organizes a post-show trivia game but excludes Jeremy, who ends up meeting a woman at a bar.

videos.title: The Local Weather
videos.overview: Dan reacts to not making the “100 Most Influential People in Sports” list. Dana goes to church.

videos.title: Draft Day: Part I - It Can't Rain at Indian Wells
videos.overview: The team covers the first round of the NFL draft. Jeremy is nervous about Jenny's visit to the studio.

videos.title: Draft Day: Part II - The Fall of Ryan O'Brian
videos.overview: It's the second round of the NFL draft. Jenny visits, and Dan and Casey fight.

videos.title: April is the Cruelest Month
videos.overview: The network's cutting costs and jobs may be on the line. The staff sit for Passover Seder, and Dan hopes this will afford him the chance to mend a few fences.

videos.title: Bells and a Siren
videos.overview: Natalie has a job interview with Saturday Night Live. Dan hires a publicist.

videos.title: La Forza Del Destino
videos.overview: Dana meets a man with inside information on the sale of the network. Dan and Casey have a job offer in Los Angeles.

videos.title: Quo Vadimus
videos.overview: Rebecca returns, Natalie and Jeremy rekindle their relationship, and the network is sold.

awards: Won 3 Primetime Emmys. 13 wins & 37 nominations total
